title: Prajna Paramita Retreat 2
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The teacher emphasizes the importance of cultivating the six paramitas (perfections) in order to bring about awakening and benefit all beings, but notes that these are not states or destinations, but rather processes to be cultivated. This approach encourages a mindset of openness, acceptance, and letting go, allowing for a kind of "immersion" in the present moment where one can release attachment to thoughts and ideas and simply be. By embracing this process, one can develop perfect wisdom and find freedom from attachments and limitations.
